race.comment: BOLD BUCKS (6) was sent out as a rock solid $1.65 chance last start at Nowra but after giving away at least six lengths on the bend could not bridge the gap and was beaten in a three-way go. His figures suggest a step up to provincial level is not out of reach. Hard to beat in the wide-open spaces of Kembla. BRUTAL ADVANCE (1) registered his eighth minor placing from 14 runs when a fast finishing second over this course and distance last time out. Cherry ripe after two runs back from a spell. Must win one sooner or later. BASCILICA BABE (9) led for the judge but was headed soon after and finished a distant third over 1300m at Hawkesbury recently. Getting down in the weights and 1200m is a good option. Not out of contention. CLINGER POWER (10) came from near the tail to finish fifth on debut over 1100m at Hawkesbury last start. Better placed here over 1200m so expect some improvement on that effort. ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (12) will find this easier than her moderate debut in town.
